intent: Individually authored day-part, preposition and midnight-rollover tasks, with an opt-in code clock model. All travel arrangements original; no mastery or audio credit.
picturePurpose: The inspected original day/night courtyard supports an actual night recognition task. A code-drawn changing clock and day label supply exact time evidence; generated darkness never establishes midnight.

workshop.title: 拨过中午和午夜，把日期读对
workshop.instruction: 先按记录辨时间、选搭配。两次拨钟比较同样十五分钟之后的日期，再用自己的句子说清安排。

items.label: morning：通常的早晨，还是周五早上？
items.prompt: 记录明确说“在周五早上见面”。哪句保留了具体某一天？

wordDecision.prompt: 记录明确说“在周五早上见面”。哪句保留了具体某一天？

items.material: The market is busiest in the morning.
items.before: The market is busiest in the
items.reason: 通常说in the morning；指定周五早上说on Friday morning。morning本身不是遇到就固定配in，先看有没有某一天或别的限定。

options.text: We will meet on Friday morning.
options.reason: 具体某天早上用on Friday morning。

options.text: We usually meet in the morning.
options.reason: 这说通常在早上见面，没有保留周五这个指定日期。

options.text: We will meet in Friday morning.
options.reason: Friday限定具体某一天，此处不用in。

items.label: afternoon：this一出现，别再加in
items.prompt: 记录：我们今天下午完成海报。哪句时间表达自然？

wordDecision.prompt: 记录：我们今天下午完成海报。哪句时间表达自然？

items.material: Let's finish the painting this afternoon.
items.reason: in the afternoon说在下午；this afternoon说今天下午，直接用这个短语。afternoons可表示多个下午；不要把in the afternoon的in机械保留到this afternoon前。
items.hint: in the afternoon → this afternoon，不再加in。

options.text: We will finish the poster this afternoon.
options.reason: this afternoon直接作时间状语。

options.text: We will finish the poster in this afternoon.
options.reason: 这里this afternoon前不加in。

options.text: We will finish the poster on this afternoon.
options.reason: 这里this afternoon前不加on。

items.label: evening：读清傍晚的起止时间
items.prompt: 原创安排：Evening walk 18:30–19:00. When does this walk finish?

wordDecision.prompt: 原创安排：Evening walk 18:30–19:00. When does this walk finish?

items.material: We enjoy a short walk in the evening.
items.before: We enjoy a short walk in the
items.reason: in the evening是常见搭配；on Friday evening指定周五晚上。evening的实际范围依情境而变，不能据一个词猜精确钟点；本题18:30和19:00来自原创安排。
items.hint: in the evening；on Friday evening；18:30开始，19:00结束。

options.reason: 18:30是开始时间，不能回答finish。
同一项活动后一个钟点19:00是结束时间。

options.text: For thirty minutes.
options.reason: 这说时长，不是When询问的结束钟点。

items.label: night：选夜景，但别凭夜色猜午夜
items.prompt: 原创记录：The courtyard lights stay on at night. 点符合night的场景。

wordDecision.prompt: 原创记录：The courtyard lights stay on at night. 点符合night的场景。

art.alt: 同一学校庭院的昼夜对照。左边日光明亮，右边深蓝夜空和楼内亮灯。图片只用于辨别night，不能证明正好是午夜；精确时间来自另两题的代码钟面。

evidence.caption: 右图已选。核对night；夜色不提供精确钟点。
左图已选。核对night；夜色不提供精确钟点。

items.material: A small lamp stays on at night.
items.before: A small lamp stays on at
items.reason: 通常说at night；on Friday night指定周五晚上。夜色只能帮助辨认night，不能证明正好是midnight。in the night在某些语境也可表示夜间发生的事，不能概括成英语里一律不存在。
items.hint: at night；on Friday night；night不等于正好midnight。

options.text: The school courtyard at night.
options.reason: 右图深蓝夜空和亮灯支持night场景。

options.text: The school courtyard in daylight.
options.reason: 左图是白昼，不符合本条记录。

items.label: noon：推过十五分钟，看是不是中午
items.prompt: 原创记录：It is 11:45 on Friday. We will meet fifteen minutes later. 先拨动时间模型，再选见面的时间。

wordDecision.prompt: 原创记录：It is 11:45 on Friday. We will meet fifteen minutes later. 先拨动时间模型，再选见面的时间。

clock.title: 把等待的时间拨出来
clock.hint: 先试不同的等待时长，再回到记录要求的fifteen minutes。
clock.wrong: 记录要求再过十五分钟。核对你选的等待时长，再看钟点和日期。

items.material: Meet me outside the hall at noon.
items.before: Meet me outside the hall at
items.reason: noon指中午十二点，常说at noon。十一点四十五分再过十五分钟是当天中午；同一个钟面的十二点也可能指午夜，所以要结合24小时钟点和日期标签。

options.text: At noon on Friday.
options.reason: 11:45再过十五分钟是当天12:00，即noon。

options.text: At midnight between Friday and Saturday.
options.reason: noon是中午；午夜要从23:45再过十五分钟。

options.text: At 11:45 on Friday.
options.reason: 这还是等待前的钟点，没有加上十五分钟。

items.label: midnight：同样十五分钟，这次会换一天
items.prompt: 原创记录：It is 23:45 on Friday. Wait fifteen minutes. 先拨动模型，再选等候结束时的时间。

wordDecision.prompt: 原创记录：It is 23:45 on Friday. Wait fifteen minutes. 先拨动模型，再选等候结束时的时间。

clock.title: 拨过午夜，观察日期变化
clock.hint: 先试不同的等待时长，再回到记录要求的fifteen minutes。
clock.wrong: 记录要求再过十五分钟。核对你选的等待时长，再看是否跨入周六。

items.material: The last train leaves just before midnight.
items.before: The last train leaves just before
items.reason: midnight是午夜十二点，跨到新一天时24小时钟写00:00。Friday 23:45再过十五分钟是Saturday 00:00；别只看钟面两个指针都到十二点，就把noon和midnight混成同一时间。

options.text: Noon on Friday.
options.reason: 23:45是深夜，不能推成当天中午。

options.text: Midnight, as Friday changes to Saturday.
options.reason: 23:45再过十五分钟是Saturday 00:00，已经进入周六。

options.text: 23:45 on Friday.
options.reason: 没有加上记录要求的十五分钟。

items.label: today：今天不是固定的星期几
items.prompt: 原创便条开头写着：Today is Friday. 哪个动作明确安排在今天？

wordDecision.prompt: 原创便条开头写着：Today is Friday. 哪个动作明确安排在今天？

items.material: We can make a fresh start today.
items.before: We can make a fresh start
items.reason: today通常直接作时间状语，如start today，不加on或in。今天是哪一天由便条写作时间决定；这条写着Today is Friday，换一天写便条，today的日期也会变。
items.hint: 本条便条：today = Friday；日期由上下文确定。

options.text: Pack the bag tomorrow, on Saturday.
options.reason: Saturday是这条便条里的明天，不是今天。

options.text: Pack the bag today, on Friday.
options.reason: 便条已把today限定为Friday，今天收拾包。

options.text: Pack the bag on Friday every week.
options.reason: 这变成每周五的重复安排，便条只说今天。

items.label: tomorrow：明天的日期，先找今天
items.prompt: 原创便条：Today is Friday. Our train leaves at 00:20 tomorrow. 这里tomorrow是哪一天？

wordDecision.prompt: 原创便条：Today is Friday. Our train leaves at 00:20 tomorrow. 这里tomorrow是哪一天？

items.material: Save the harder questions for tomorrow.
items.reason: tomorrow表示明天；直接作时间状语时不加on，如leave tomorrow。原句for tomorrow把题目留待明天，for说明用途或安排，不等于on tomorrow。午夜后要核对日期，不能只看自己还没睡就当作同一天。
items.hint: Today is Friday → tomorrow is Saturday；00:20属于新一天。

options.text: Friday.
options.reason: Friday是便条里的今天，不是明天。

options.text: Saturday.
options.reason: 今天是Friday，下一天是Saturday；00:20已经进入新一天。

options.text: Sunday.
options.reason: Sunday是周五的后天，多推了一天。

transfer.stem: Which plan follows this family travel note?
transfer.passage:
FRIDAY FAMILY TRAVEL NOTE
Today is Friday. Meet our relatives outside the hall at noon today. Our train leaves at 00:20 tomorrow. Be at the station at 23:45 tonight. It takes exactly fifteen minutes to check the tickets. After checking, wait twenty more minutes for the train to leave. These are original practice arrangements, not a real train timetable.

options.text: Meet outside the hall at 00:00 on Friday and reach the station at 23:45.
Reach the station at 23:45 on Saturday for a train leaving at 00:20 on Saturday.
Meet outside the hall at 12:00 on Friday, reach the station at 23:45 on Friday, and leave at 00:20 on Saturday.
Reach the station at 23:45 on Friday and leave at 00:00 on Saturday, as soon as checking ends.

answer.display: Meet outside the hall at 12:00 on Friday, reach the station at 23:45 on Friday, and leave at 00:20 on Saturday.

explanation.strategy: 先确定today是哪一天，再把中午和跨午夜后的钟点放回各自日期。

steps.text: 今天是周五；at noon today是在周五12:00见面，今晚23:45到车站。
steps.reason: noon是中午，不是00:00。today和tonight都以便条开头的Friday为准。

steps.text: 23:45检查十五分钟，到周六00:00；再等二十分钟，周六00:20发车。
steps.reason: 跨过midnight便进入Saturday。tomorrow是周六，检查结束不是发车，还要加twenty more minutes。

distractors.reason: 把到站日也推成Saturday；周六23:45已经晚于周六00:20的发车时间。
漏掉检查后还要等待的二十分钟，把00:00的检查结束当成发车。

explanation.pitfall: 午夜会换日期；noon、midnight和发车时间分别核对，别把“检查结束”当成“出发”。

visual.title: 同一段等待，跨入下一天
visual.caption: 日期、24小时钟点和等待时长由原创便条给出；生成的夜色不能证明午夜。

explanation.transfer: 如果到站时间改为周五23:35，检查仍需十五分钟，列车仍在周六00:20发车，检查几点结束？还要等多久？
